Question B-005-004-011.

Why the correct answer is right: Convert 300 mA to 0.3 A, then R = 3 V / 0.3 A = 10 ohms.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "9 ohms": This multiplies 3 by 3 after treating 300 mA as 3 instead of 0.3 A.
- sourceIndex 2: "5 ohms": This does not match 3 divided by 0.3; it is half of the correct resistance.
- sourceIndex 3: "3 ohms": This repeats the voltage value instead of using Ohm’s law; 3 V / 0.3 A is 10 ohms.
